entries.title: Plugin dependency enforcement
entries.paragraph: You can no longer disable a plugin that other plugins depend on. Claude Code reads the dependency graph and blocks the toggle with a clear error.

entries.title: claude agents dashboard + /goal command
entries.paragraph: New claude agents opens a dashboard showing every active session. New /goal sets completion conditions and shows elapsed time, turns, and tokens live.
entries.whyItMatters: See every parallel session in one view. /goal stops runaway agents.

example.code: /goal Stop after one PR comment per finding

suggestions.title: Wrap long-running Claude sessions with /goal
suggestions.paragraph: Any nightly automation or PR-review pass that runs Claude unattended benefits from a hard done-condition. /goal adds a token + turn overlay so cost blows up are visible immediately.
suggestions.whyItMatters: Cheaper to spot runaway loops in seconds than to debug post-mortem.
